text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
"...Status updated to 'Regret.' I am 
terribly sorry, Dr. Wrights."

text_block_list.name: ST-2 (Satie)
text_block_list.text:
No, it's quite all right... After all, 
it's my fault for trying to get you to 
check the data on my tablet while you were 
running alongside ST-2.

text_block_list.name: ST-2 (Satie)
text_block_list.text:
Still... hmm. So the rumors are true? That 
you have a condition where you "destroy 
electronic devices just by touching 
them"...

text_block_list.name: ST-2 (Satie)
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Bourbon. Would you mind letting me 
study your physical constitution? I'd 
really love to unravel the principles 
behind it.

text_block_list.name: ST-2 (Satie)
text_block_list.text:
Besides... you need at least one, don't 
you? A "smartphone that won't break even 
when you touch it."

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
"...Update confirmed. Upon receiving the 
'Proposal', status has shifted from 
'Anticipation' to 'Delight.'"

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much, Doctor. If that can 
truly be realized, I would be delighted. 
...

text_block_list.name: ST-2 (Satie)
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. Now then... For the sake of 
research, let's test what happens when I 
touch it with this body.

text_block_list.name: ST-2 (Satie)
text_block_list.text:
Perfect timing, as I was in the middle of 
an experiment to "dive into ST-2 regularly 
to acclimate the body." I'll take these 
results back with me—

text_block_list.name: ST-2 (Satie)
text_block_list.text:
"...What's this? I already feel... kind of 
a prickling sensation? What on earth is 
this...?"

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Could it be that ST-2, as a 
high-performance full-dive robot, has 
detected danger? It is possible that it is 
notifying the operator.

text_block_list.name: ST-2 (Satie)
text_block_list.text:
...It seems this requires more urgent 
action than I anticipated. For both our 
sakes.
